note: Larkspur's planning numbers for a teaching simulator, not measurements of any real network, CDN or server. Every wait the Caching module shows comes from these and from the trace.

words.edge: 12 ms from a customer to their regional warehouse and back
words.depot: 60 ms for the depot to build a reply
words.distance: 2 ms of round trip for every 100 km between a warehouse and the depot
words.capacity: the depot answers 20 trips in a quarter hour without slowing down; every trip past that adds 40 ms to every trip in that quarter hour
words.swr: stale-while-revalidate may serve an expired copy for up to 30 minutes
words.purge: staff send a purge when they edit a price or a photo; stock counts change with every order and are never purged
